title.zh: North Korean fake recruiters infect 30K devices, steal $10.7M in crypto
title.en: North Korean fake recruiters infect 30K devices, steal $10.7M in crypto

current_state.zh: A multinational advisory from Japan, Germany, Australia and the US attributes a North Korean fake-recruiter malware campaign to hacking group WaterPlum, which infected at least 30,000 devices in over 100 countries and stole at least $10.7 million in crypto from developers and Web3 workers.
current_state.en: A multinational advisory from Japan, Germany, Australia and the US attributes a North Korean fake-recruiter malware campaign to hacking group WaterPlum, which infected at least 30,000 devices in over 100 countries and stole at least $10.7 million in crypto from developers and Web3 workers.
